title: Dispatch: mdke Favored Enemy humanoid races + language (Sonnet 5.5, attempt 1)
description:
Implementation plan for parent eshyra-mdke (bd show eshyra-mdke). Supervisor decisions below are made; STOP and record in notes if the code contradicts a premise. MANDATORY READING before touching the importer/pack: AGENTS.md "Deterministic rules-pack importer work", docs/importer-fix-protocol.md, docs/rules-pack-compiler.md.

WORKTREE/BRANCH: .worktrees/eshyra-mdke.1 on branch eshyra-mdke.1 (cut from current origin/main). Deps installed.

SRD (feature:ranger:favored-enemy description, verbatim in the pack): "Choose a type of favored enemy: aberrations, ... or undead. Alternatively, you can select two races of humanoid (such as gnolls and orcs) as favored enemies. ... When you gain this feature, you also learn one language of your choice that is spoken by your favored enemies, if they speak one at all. You choose one additional favored enemy, as well as an associated language, at 6th and 14th level."

CURRENT STATE
- Pack: feature:ranger:favored-enemy choices[] = [{id 'favored-enemy', category favoredEnemy, level 1, choose 1, from [13 creature types]}] derived in packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/deriveFeatureChoices.ts (~line 1090). Schema: packages/core/src/rules/featureChoices.ts (FeatureChoice) + kindSchemas.ts validator.
- Consumers: creation packages/core/src/character/creationClassChoices.ts (level 0->1 pass over level-up detectors); level-up packages/core/src/character/levelUpFeatureChoices.ts (detectFeatureChoiceDescriptors, listDescriptor, resolveFeatureChoiceSelection, applyFeatureChoicesToSheet; classifyFeatureImprovements/detectFeatureImprovementDescriptors for the ranger 6/14 'additional' pick) and levelUpChoiceCoverage.ts (coverage invariant: every pack choice on a feature gained at a level must be handled or it BLOCKS the level-up/creation). The spell module already has a conditional-choice precedent (spellFilter requiresFeatureOption, CONDITIONAL_CHOICES).
- Language data: table:standard-languages / table:exotic-languages carry projection kind 'languageOptions' (language names).

DECISIONS
1. Schema (featureChoices.ts + kindSchemas.ts validator): add optional `requiresOption?: {choiceId: string; optionId: string}` (the choice applies only when that sibling choice's option is picked in the same acquisition; validator: sibling exists on the same feature and its `from` contains optionId) and `optional?: true` (an empty selection is allowed).
2. Pack curation (importer, source-guarded, regenerate the pack with the importer, never hand-edit generated output):
   a. 'favored-enemy' `from` gains option 'humanoids' (guard: the feature text contains "two races of humanoid").
   b. New choice {id 'humanoid-races', category favoredEnemy, level 1, choose 2, prompt 'Choose two races of humanoid as favored enemies.', requiresOption {choiceId 'favored-enemy', optionId 'humanoids'}, from: humanoid race names derived from the pack, lowercase, sorted, deduped: the humanoid subtype tags of creature records whose type is "humanoid (<tags>)" (split on commas, drop 'any race' and 'shapechanger') UNION the names of base ancestry records (records without a parent race / subraceOf)}. Record in the derivation comment that the SRD set is open-ended ("such as gnolls and orcs") and this is the pack-grounded closed menu; both SRD examples must be present (guard).
   c. New choice {id 'favored-enemy-language', category language, level 1, choose 1, optional true, prompt 'Learn one language spoken by your favored enemies, if they speak one at all.', from: standard ∪ exotic language names from the two languageOptions table projections}. "Spoken by your favored enemies" remains DM-adjudicated (comment + doc).
   Run the SRD audits the protocol names; update the semi-structured boundary inventory (packages/core/scripts/inventory-semi-structured-boundary.ts, docs/inventories/...) truthfully if it flags the new paths.
3. Engine (shared by creation and level-up; keep the coverage invariant green):
   - A requiresOption choice emits its descriptor only when the sibling selection in the same acquisition includes the option (creation: the stored draft selection; level-up: the selections map); otherwise it is handled (not blocking). An optional choice is emitted with optional: true (empty selection skips).
   - Humanoid races: 2 distinct picks, excluding races already held for this feature.
   - Language pick: excludes languages already on sheet.languages (at creation: the draft's languages); a chosen language is persisted as a featureChoices entry AND appended to sheet.languages (dedupe).
   - Ranger 6/14 improvement path: the 'additional favored enemy' pick also offers the conditional humanoid-races choice and the optional language pick, all persisted at the target level.
   - Natural Explorer unchanged.
4. Existing sheets: persisted favored-enemy picks of a creature type remain valid; nothing migrates.

EVIDENCE (real pack, concise)
- Pack: favored-enemy has 'humanoids' in from; humanoid-races and favored-enemy-language exist with requiresOption/optional; gnoll and orc in the humanoid list (one assertion each, not a snapshot of the list).
- Guard unit tests: missing "two races of humanoid" text fails the import.
- Creation: ranger picking 'beasts' finalizes without humanoid races and may skip the language; ranger picking 'humanoids' must pick 2 races; language pick lands on sheet.languages.
- Level-up ranger 5->6: additional 'humanoids' pick requires 2 races; language pick appended; duplicate language refused.
- Existing ranger tests stay green.

PROTOCOL: run `npm run verify:worktree` from the worktree root BEFORE committing (it rewrites files); commit on eshyra-mdke.1; append a completion report with `bd update eshyra-mdke.1 --append-notes`; file follow-ups with bd create; `bd close eshyra-mdke.1`.
notes: Completed in commit 4b01863c on branch eshyra-mdke.1 (not pushed). Pack: favored-enemy from += 'humanoids'; new humanoid-races (choose 2, requiresOption favored-enemy/humanoids, 17 pack-derived races incl. gnoll+orc) and favored-enemy-language (optional, 16 languages from the two languageOptions tables). Generated diff limited to feature:ranger:favored-enemy in records.json; verify:dnd5e-srd-pack matches exactly. Importer guards fail closed on the three SRD phrases and on gnoll/orc absence. Schema: FeatureChoice requiresOption/optional + sibling validator. Engine: triggerSatisfied/reusableOptionIds in levelUpFeatureChoices, languageChoice descriptor flag + applied.languages appended to sheet.languages (level-up) and via CreationChoiceApplication.languages (creation); improvement path picks all list siblings of a favoredEnemy/naturalExplorer feature; 'humanoids' re-pickable at 6/14, held races excluded. Inventory regenerated (requiresOption paths classified complete). Existing tests changed: deriveFeatureChoices favored-enemy fixtures now use full guarded SRD text and expect 'humanoids' in from (strengthened; synthetic text was too narrow for the new guard); creationClassChoices ranger count [13,7] -> [14,15,7]. verify:worktree green (335 files, 6181 tests). Not done: DM adjudication of which languages favored enemies speak stays prose; creation language dedupe vs later ancestry language pick relies on Set merge. Follow-up: validator negative tests bead.
